NeoV8 for Linux (x86-64; glibc 2.35 or later: Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 36 and newer)
=============================================================================================

Uses only the usual desktop libraries: ALSA (libasound2), OpenGL, X11/xcb and the Wayland client library. JACK is
used when installed. LOAD BANK opens the desktop's file chooser (xdg-desktop-portal). Nothing else to install.

App:     ./neov8   (ALSA by default, which also works through PipeWire; ./neov8 --backend jack for JACK;
         ./neov8 --help for every option).
         Menu entry: copy neov8.desktop to ~/.local/share/applications/ (edit its Exec= line to where neov8 is)
         and neov8.png to ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/.
Plugins: copy NeoV8.clap to ~/.clap/ and NeoV8.vst3 (the whole folder) to ~/.vst3/, then rescan in your DAW.

The Octave-Plateau factory bank (cassette B2: 100 programs, 100 steps) is built in and loaded on the first start.
It is also here as voyetra-factory-b2.syx: LOAD BANK reloads it, and any SysEx tool can send it to a real Voyetra
Eight (see banks/README.md in the source). LOAD BANK also takes other banks (SysEx .syx, cassette recording .wav,
8 KB battery image .bin). Your programs are kept in ~/.local/share/neov8/battery.bin
(the app) or in the DAW project (the plugin).

NeoV8 is free software (GPL-3.0-or-later): https://github.com/r0main-f/neov8
